levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The script is missing one or more of the three parts: naming the signal, when it started, or what is needed.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The script includes all three parts in order.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The script includes all three parts in order, using calm, specific wording for each part.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The learner cannot recall or name a specific earlier signal.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner names a specific signal and roughly when it happened.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner names the specific signal, when it happened, and why it went unmentioned at the time.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The learner cannot write a script for a different signal than the one already practiced.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner writes a complete three-part script for a new signal.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner writes a complete script for a new signal that is fully distinct from the one just practiced, with different wording throughout.

lookFors: The three parts of each script always appear in the same order: name, timing, need.
No script frames the earlier unmentioned signal as a mistake or a failure to speak up.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
